title: eXc ArmorUI
description: Shows your worn armor next to the hotbar with durability. Only displays the pieces you actually wear, and fades while a menu is open. Styled in a turquoise to purple look.
body:
A clean armor overlay that shows the gear you are wearing right next to your
hotbar, with the durability of each piece. Only the slots you actually use are
shown, so it stays out of your way.
- **Worn armor display** — helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots shown left to
  right next to the hotbar.
